title: Variables & Types
description: Learn about variables, types, and type conversions in Go
theory:
## Variables in Python 3

Bindings use `=`; types are dynamic. Use `print()` for stdout. Constants are convention (`MAX = 100`), not enforced.

exercises.title: Declare a Variable
exercises.description: Declare a variable age of type int and assign it the value 25. Then use print to print it.
hints: Use age int = 25 or age := 25 to declare and assign

exercises.title: Multiple Variable Declaration
exercises.description: Declare two variables: name (string) with value "Pythonlang" and version (float64) with value 1.21. Print them on the same line separated by a space.

exercises.title: Type Conversion
exercises.description: Declare an integer variable x with value 100. Convert it to a float64 and store in y. Print the result.
hints: Use float64(x) to convert int to float64

exercises.title: Zero Values
exercises.description: Declare variables of type int, float64, string, and bool without assigning values. Print each one to see their zero values.
exercises.starter_code: # int_var, float_var, str_var, bool_var — use defaults, then print all four.
hints: intVar int declares an int with zero value 0
strVar string has zero value "" (empty string)
boolVar bool has zero value false

exercises.title: Constants
exercises.description: Create a constant named MaxScore with value 100 and a constant named MinScore with value 0. Print both constants.
hints: Use const MaxScore = 100 (Go infers the type)

exercises.title: Grouped Variable Declaration
exercises.description: Use a grouped var declaration to declare host (string, "localhost"), port (int, 8080), and debug (bool, true). Print all three values.
exercises.starter_code:
# host, port, debug = "localhost", 8080, True
# print(host, port, debug)
hints: Use ( host string = "localhost"; port int = 8080; debug bool = true )
exercises.solution:
host, port, debug = "localhost", 8080, True
print(host, port, debug)

exercises.title: Variable Swap
exercises.description: Declare two variables a and b with values 5 and 10. Swap their values without using a temp variable. Print the values after swapping.
hints: In Go, you can swap in one line: a, b = b, a
exercises.solution:
a, b = 5, 10
a, b = b, a
print(a, b)
